title: Module comparison in degree zero without acyclicity
statement: Let i:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], r a natural number, and assume the canonical section restriction is an isomorphism for every Z/rZ-module-valued etale sheaf on X [def-weil-pbc-finite-section-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For each such M, the canonical abelian cohomology pullback H^0(X,U(M))→H^0(Y,i^*U(M)) is bijective [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. There is no assumption about positive cohomology or primality.
